text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Leader. I collected some old nails—should these go to the conference room?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, I'm heading there now, so I'll bring it over!
Where is it?"

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Boss Tama-chan!
That looks dangerous, let me carry it!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fine, I tell ya!
How old do ya think I am?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some time has passed since Tamamo Cross became the leader. However, whether she is actually relied upon as a leader... remains questionable.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Umm,
let's see what everyone's catering is today...

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: Ah, I'll carry it instead! It's a huge load, after all!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: No, no, I can carry it too, ya know!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...*pant*, *whew*.
Hup, heave-ho...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you feelin' sick or somethin'?
Don't push yerself, get some rest!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
No, no, I'm fine! If I step down,
Leader Tama-chan will end up having to do it all by herself!
I can't let that happen, no way!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I really wish you'd just lean on me with everything ya got, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, it does feel like they're being a bit too considerate. She may look small, but she's a capable, dependable upperclassman on the inside.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Honestly, you could throw a tantrum and stomp your feet
saying you're starving just like the little ones back home,
and I wouldn't mind at all, y'know~?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Working constantly in an unfamiliar environment
like a deserted island is exhausting, ya know.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
I took on the role of leader wanting
to support everyone through things like that, though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Then one day...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaaaa!!!
Stay away, stay away, you stupid boar--!!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Wh-Wh-Wh-What the heck?!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I-It seems Windy-senpai did something
to make them mad~!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! That's not true!
I was just gathering acorns and the wild boar got mad!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
You just snatched its food, ya dummy!
J-J-Just don't run away!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The moment Shinko Windy dashed off—!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Gyah!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tripping over a tree root, she took a hard fall...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A wild boar charging in!
Shinko Windy frozen in place!
The moment I instinctively tried to rush overâ

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Nuwaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grab! Rrrroll...!)

text_block_list.name: Wild Boar
text_block_list.text: Bmoooh!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Y-You saved me!
Gaaah, Tamamo-senpai~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross rolled out of the way while holding Shinko Windy, successfully avoiding the boar's charge...!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
That was super awesome!
Tama-chan—no! Tamamo Leader!

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
You put yourself on the line to save Windy-san!
You were super cool!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: He-heheheheh! Aw shucks, somethin' like that was a piece of cake!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Hmph, didn't you know? Despite how she looks,
Tamamo-senpai can actually pull her weight when it counts!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
"Despite how you look" was totally uncalled for!
—Well, yeah, fair enough! I'm actually pretty good at this!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: "I'll do my best as leader till the very end, so don't hesitate to lean on me as much as you need!"

text_block_list.name: PJ Participant Umamusumes
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe!
That's one step forward!
